t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes seem to determine which ones are good value. Under 3 mushrooms is considered an undesirable pick. Values of gnomes can change through the game so be prepared to change choices potentially.

vb_textbox.text: Try and work out which colour in each pair of gnomes typically produces more mushrooms. Through each trial it can change, once it seems to have changed it will stay that way for quite a few trials. Try and do safer bets on 5x trials and use the 1x trials to check if the luck has switched to the other colour gnome sometimes.
